dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, you do have a point.

dialogues.speaker: Yikuo
dialogues.text: Exactly, right? Life is brutish and short. Working hard every day is fine and all, but is it worth it?

dialogues.speaker: Yikuo
dialogues.text: Rather than sacrifice everything on the altar of work like my colleagues, isn't it better to take breaks like this?

dialogues.speaker: Yikuo
dialogues.text: Life is long, why the rush and the chase?

dialogues.speaker: Yikuo
dialogues.text: So, you should relax, too. Sit here, take a break, have some tea, try some these Fried Radish Balls... enjoy life rather than suffer it.
